title: Port of Los Angeles — Severe Congestion
description: Extreme vessel backlog at POLA berths 200-209. Average dwell time increased to 11 days. Affecting all inbound Asia-Pacific routes.

title: Winter Storm — I-80 Corridor Closed
description: Blizzard conditions on I-80 between Chicago and Denver. CDOT has issued chain law restrictions. Multiple accidents blocking westbound lanes.

title: FastFreight Systems — IT Outage
description: FastFreight ERP system offline following ransomware incident. Track-and-trace, dispatch, and billing systems unavailable. Estimated recovery 48 hours.

title: Panama Canal — Transit Restrictions
description: Canal Authority has imposed draft restrictions due to low water levels. Maximum draft reduced to 44 feet. Delays of 3-5 days for fully loaded vessels.

title: I-10 Bridge Closure — Phoenix
description: Emergency structural inspection has closed I-10 eastbound bridge over the Salt River. Traffic diverted via SR-51 adding 45 minutes to transit.
affected_region: Phoenix, AZ — I-10 Salt River Bridge
